differences.native: LeetCode requires a MySQL getUserIDs(startDate, endDate, minAmount) procedure whose SELECT returns the result set.
differences.app: The SQLite harness supplies those arguments as one Parameters row and executes the procedure's SELECT body directly.
differences.rationale: SQLite cannot create or invoke MySQL stored procedures. The app adapter changes only parameter transport; the inclusive timestamp filter, amount threshold, distinct projection, ordering, and complexity match.
